title: Sliding-Window Streaming VLM Smoke Test — Qwen3.8-27B vs Muse Glimmer 30B
summary: Two offline VLMs wrapped as causal online assistants (8-frame sliding visual window + self-generated recurrent text memory, media-time replay) on five randomly sampled items from each of Ego-MC-Bench, Wearable AI, StreamingBench, OVO-Bench and ProactiveVideoQA. All 50 trajectories ran end to end; official or adapted scores where no LLM judge is needed.

title: Human–Device Simulation — a rigged human operating a microwave (3D render + MuJoCo contact)
summary: Reproducible 3D pipeline: a clothed MPFB human with IK-driven hands operates a CC BY 4.0 microwave model in Blender; the START key is driven by MuJoCo contact against a kinematic fingertip proxy with a negative control; door, knob and bowl use labelled assisted grasps. One recorded 51 s run rendered from external, first-person and hand-detail cameras (preview quality).
